title: Trade review 25 Nov: 4 results, 5 lessons, 1 change made
summary: 1 at T2, 1 partial at T1, 0 failed, 2 missed winners. GRANULES hit T2 for +6.62%; ONGC closed +0.81%. Change: buy up to 2% above zone top.
body_md:
**🧾 Trade review, Wed 25 Nov**

**Change made: buy up to 2% above the zone top. GRANULES hit T2, ONGC closed, 2 missed winners.**

A better day. GRANULES closed at T2 and ONGC closed with a small gain, so all 95 closed trades now total +134.6% (average +1.4%), against +127.2% from 93 on Monday. Nifty rose 1.85% to 25,819.25. 16 trades are still running, 11 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 111 bought trades is +1.0%. One new pick was listed (BHARATFORG). The next 30-day exit is ESCORTS (−7.2%, T1 booked) on Fri 27 Nov, then five 3 Nov buys on 3 Dec.

**Today's results**

- ✅✅ **GRANULES** (Candle at support, listed 6 Nov): T2 hit, trade closed: T1 was reported on 12 Nov. Bought ₹800.80 on 9 Nov, sold at T2 ₹853.84 today, +6.62% in 16 days, worst dip −4.07%. Its setup had all the strong signs: a strong hammer on 4.0× volume at a weekly swing low, and it fell 5.4% in the month before listing. It traded 4.2% cheaper inside the window, and a zone-bottom buy at ₹782.05 would have made +9.2%.
- ✅ **ONGC** (Candle at support, listed 23 Oct): partial win, trade closed: T1 was reported on 2 Nov (₹225.09 → ₹231.84 in 7 days). The other half closed near ₹222.00 at the 30-day mark, so the whole trade averages ₹226.92: +0.81% in 30 days, worst dip only −2.44%.
- ⚪ **GALLANTT** (Pullback, listed 19 Nov): never bought, a missed winner: It came within 1.44% of the zone top (₹524.06) but never dipped in. A zone+2% buy at ₹534.54 on 20 Nov would have reached T1 on 23 Nov and T2 since, for +3.92% (worst dip −0.42%). It listed on 0.24× volume after falling 13.9% in a month.
- ⚪ **PFC** (Candle at support, listed 19 Nov): never bought, a missed winner: It came within 0.42% of the zone top (₹322.75). A zone+2% or next-open buy at ₹329.20 on 20 Nov would have hit T1 (₹332.43) the same day, worst dip −1.55%. Its earlier listing closed at T2.

GRANULES and ONGC closed today. Plus 64 earlier. These 74 wins (56 at T2, 18 partial) made +353.0%; with the 21 failures (−218.3% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed flat) all 95 closed trades total +134.6%. 9 of the 18 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (5): PERSISTENT (23 Nov), UNIONBANK and INDIANB (20 Nov), LUPIN (9 Nov) and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 2 of these 5 are below their buy price (ESCORTS −7.2%, INDIANB −0.4%).

**Missed and better entries**

- **Missed winners now 23 of 35:** GALLANTT and PFC are new tonight; both came within 1.5% of the zone. 27 of the 35 never bought came within 2% of the zone. TECHM (listed 20 Nov) is still waiting, 1.1% above its zone.
- **Zone up to 2% higher clears the bar:** Fills 94.1% vs 78.5% as listed: 15.6 points against the bar of 15, the first time over it after 14.0 to 14.7 in every review since 17 Nov. T1 rate of decided trades is better, 85.5% vs 79.0%, and the worst dip is shallower (−6.9% vs −7.4%). Its 114 closed trades made +170.0%, against +134.6% from 95 real ones, with 27 losing trades against 26.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.1% vs −7.4% as listed, 1.2 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 112 closed trades made +199.4% with 22 losing trades; average closed trade +1.8% against +1.4%.

**Lessons**

- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −2.8% (closed and open), and their 26 closed trades net −81.7% with 12 of the 21 failures. Off the list since 4 Nov. The 23 retest near misses logged since then: 7 at T1, 5 at T2, best rise 3.5% on average. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** 14 of the 17 real failures rose 5% or more in the month before listing. Those 40 trades net −119.5% from 34 closed trades; the other 71 made +254.0% from 61 closed trades, 43 at T2. Both of today's wins fell in the month before listing. Still my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change. (holding)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 39 of 49 bought reached T1 (80%) and 31 reached T2 (63%); their 39 closed trades made +176.6% with 4 failures, and they dip least (−4.0%). Both of today's closed trades are from this group. (holding)
- **F&O stocks do far better than cash stocks:** 43 F&O trades: 28 at T2 (65%), worst dip −3.3%. 57 cash trades: 20 at T2 (35%), worst dip −11.4%. GRANULES, a cash stock, won today. (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 23 of 35 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open; 27 of the 35 came within 2% of the zone. This is the lesson behind tonight's change. (holding, acted on)

**Early sign, from a tracker group:** picks with trigger volume under 1.5× reach T2 less often (41 of 88, 47%; worst dip −7.8%) than those at 1.5–2.5× (10 of 15, 67%) or over 2.5× (5 of 8, 63%, GRANULES today at 4.0×). No fixed entry rule tests it, so it stays an early sign. Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (49 of 49).

**Change made**

Support picks now count as bought when price comes within 2% above the zone top, not only when it dips into the zone. This is the tracker's own 'Zone up to 2% above top' rule. T1 and T2 stay measured from the zone top (+3% and +6%), and the 15 to 30 day hold is unchanged. It applies to new listings from tomorrow; past and closed trades are not touched. Evidence on 136 support picks: 22 more trades (128 vs 106), fills 94.1% vs 78.5%, T1 rate 85.5% vs 79.0%, closed total +170.0% vs +134.6%. The risk: a buy up to 2% above the zone sits closer to T1, so each win is smaller (GALLANTT would have closed at T2 for +3.9%, not +6%), and it took 27 losing trades against 26. I sent it to the coordinator to apply in the scan. Reply "undo" here to reverse it.

**Bug check**

Nothing found. 111 bought = 56 at T2 + 18 partial + 21 failed + 16 running; T1 hit 79 ≥ T2 hit 56; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit, and no closed price, date or return changed. The only changes against Monday are GRANULES and ONGC closing, GALLANTT and PFC expiring, and the new BHARATFORG listing.
